headline: NINE-NIL
ticker: REAL GRUMBLE SACK MANAGER AFTER NINE-NIL DEFEAT
CAREERCRASH.ORG: THE PERSONAL TRAINER IS ON STAGE FOUR

beats.text: Sport now, and a shock result: Real Grumble lost nine-nil on Saturday.
The club has sacked its manager, who blamed the defeat on, quote, bad vibes.
Let's bring in our Sports and Wellness guy. Brody! What went wrong?
Great question, Brock. Honestly? Nine is a LOT of reps. Those boys were working.
Brody, they lost. Nine goals went in.
Love that. Nine goals, nine intentions. But did they hydrate?
Brody, do you know what football is?
Of course, Philippa. It's when twenty-two people agree to do cardio. Smoothie?
I'll take a smoothie, Brody! What's in it?
Kale, Brock. It's always kale. Your posture's really improving, by the way.
Brock is slouching. Brock has slouched since 2019.
I am NOT slouching! I am LEANING INTO THE NEWS!

realStory.text: Made up. Heavy defeats and sacked managers are real; 'bad vibes' as the official reason is, for now, ours. Brody would like you to drink some water.

signoff: Brody brought everyone a smoothie after the brawl. He called it a great session.
